stories.title: RSM Classic R1 — Svensson Leads at -8 After Back-Nine 29

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Jesper Svensson shot a back-nine 29 today at Sea Island.

That's a 64 on the Plantation Course. He leads the RSM Classic at -8 after Round 1.

Greyserman and Higgo are right there at -7. #RSMClassic

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
The RSM Classic isn't just another fall event.

Top 100 in FedEx Cup Fall standings = full 2027 PGA Tour status.

Svensson leads at -8. The bubble players are watching every stroke. #PGATour #RSMClassic

facebook.long_form:
Jesper Svensson had one of those back nines you remember.

The 29 he posted on the back of the Plantation Course at Sea Island gave him a 64 and the Round 1 lead at the RSM Classic — eight under par, two clear of a tie for second between Max Greyserman and Garrick Higgo.

Five players sit at -6 behind them: Lee Hodges, Emiliano Grillo, Hank Lebioda, Maverick McNealy, and Davis Riley. This field is loaded at the top.

The RSM Classic runs through Sunday at Sea Island Golf Club, St. Simons Island, Georgia. With a $7.4M purse and 2027 PGA Tour status hanging in the balance for bubble players, every shot this week carries weight. Round 2 is underway today.
facebook.image_caption: Jesper Svensson leads the RSM Classic at -8 after firing a 64 — including a back-nine 29 — on the Plantation Course at Sea Island. #RSMClassic #PGATour

stories.title: CME Group Tour Championship — Korda Surges With R2 64 to Contend

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Nelly Korda opened the CME Group Tour Championship at -4. T-20.

Then she went out and shot 64 in Round 2.

World No. 1 is now in contention at the LPGA's $11M finale. First win of 2026 is in sight. #CMEGroupTour

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
CME Group Tour Championship leaderboard after R1:

🏌️‍♀️ Thitikul -7
🏌️‍♀️ A Lim Kim -7
🏌️‍♀️ Davidson -7
🏌️‍♀️ Hull -6

Korda shot 64 in R2 to surge. $2M is on the line this weekend in Naples. #LPGA

facebook.long_form:
Nelly Korda reminded everyone she's still the world's best golfer.

After opening the CME Group Tour Championship at -4 and sitting T-20, the world No. 1 came back out in Round 2 and shot a 64. Six under at Tiburón Golf Club in Naples, Florida — moving her squarely into contention at the LPGA Tour's $11 million season finale.

She'll need to reel in Round 1 co-leaders Atthaya Thitikul, A Lim Kim, and Karis Davidson, who all shot 65 on Thursday. Thitikul closed her opening round with five consecutive birdies.

The champion here takes home $2 million — the richest prize in women's golf history. And Korda hasn't won yet in 2026. That's all the motivation she needs heading into the weekend.

stories.title: LIV Golf Is Officially Winding Down

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf is done.

At a New Jersey bankruptcy hearing on November 5, LIV declared it is "toggling to a value-maximizing wind-down." The BC Partners rescue investment (~$300M) was withdrawn.

The 2027 LIV schedule will not happen. #LIVGolf

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf's final event was August 2026 in Indianapolis.

Jon Rahm reportedly forfeited ~$100M in guaranteed contract claims to exit.

The PGA Tour one-year ban still applies to returning players. The era is over. #LIVGolf #PGATour

facebook.long_form:
LIV Golf is over.

At a bankruptcy hearing in New Jersey on November 5, LIV's lawyers declared the league is "toggling to a value-maximizing wind-down." The restructuring plan — sometimes called LIV 2.0 — has been scrapped. The BC Partners Credit rescue investment of approximately $300 million was withdrawn.

LIV filed for Chapter 11 in September 2026, months after Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund pulled its backing in April. The league's last competitive event was held in Indianapolis in August 2026. There will be no 2027 LIV season.

Jon Rahm, one of the league's marquee signings, reportedly forfeited approximately $100 million in guaranteed contract claims in order to exit.

Players returning to the PGA Tour will face a one-year ban under existing policy.

Three years, billions of dollars, and a fractured sport — and now it comes to a close at a bankruptcy courthouse.
facebook.image_caption: LIV Golf officially announced a wind-down at a New Jersey bankruptcy hearing on November 5, ending the tour's three-year run. #LIVGolf #Golf

stories.title: McIlroy's Record-Tying Eighth Race to Dubai Title

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Rory McIlroy won his 8th Race to Dubai title.

He didn't even need to win the final tournament — he secured the season crown on points after Tyrrell Hatton took the finale.

Eight. Record-tying. #DPWorldTour #RaceToDubai

facebook.long_form:
Rory McIlroy doesn't need a trophy to win the title that matters most.

McIlroy secured his eighth Race to Dubai crown for the 2026 DP World Tour season — a record-tying achievement — without winning the final tournament. Tyrrell Hatton claimed victory in the season's closing event in Dubai, but McIlroy had accumulated enough points over the course of the year to claim the season-long title on points alone.

Eight Race to Dubai titles. It's the kind of number that defines a generation's dominance over a circuit. McIlroy has bridged the gap between the PGA Tour and the DP World Tour for years, and this latest milestone adds another chapter to a career that keeps finding new records to match.
facebook.image_caption: Rory McIlroy clinched his record-tying eighth Race to Dubai title for the 2026 DP World Tour season. #RaceToDubai #DPWorldTour #RoryMcIlroy

stories.title: RSM Classic Bubble Watch — Tour Cards on the Line

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Billy Horschel is on the PGA Tour status bubble heading into the RSM Classic.

Top 100 in FedEx Cup Fall standings earn full 2027 cards.

Sea Island this week is about more than a trophy. #RSMClassic #PGATour

facebook.long_form:
For the players outside the top 100 in the FedEx Cup Fall standings, this week at Sea Island is everything.

The RSM Classic is the PGA Tour's final fall event, and the top 100 players in the FedEx Cup Fall standings after the final round earn guaranteed status for the 2027 season. That means the difference between Sunday's last putt and a full PGA Tour card — or a trip back through Korn Ferry qualifying — could come down to a single shot.

Billy Horschel is among the notable names fighting for position on the bubble. The two-course format at Sea Island — players alternate between the Plantation Course and the Seaside Course in Rounds 1 and 2 before the cut, with Rounds 3 and 4 played exclusively on Seaside — adds a strategic wrinkle to an already pressure-filled week.

There's no second chance after Sunday. Watch the leaderboard carefully.
facebook.image_caption: The RSM Classic at Sea Island is the PGA Tour's last opportunity for bubble players to crack the top 100 in FedEx Cup Fall standings and secure 2027 status. #RSMClassic #PGATour
